tests.name: One persistent shell and stable controls survive nested mutations
Open is a 950ms continuous rear/side reveal with no frame-by-frame layout reads
Open→close→open preserves exact current pose and cancels stale completions
Close lasts 650ms and its completed ID becomes stale after a new intent
Duplicate open and nested resize calls retain one active opening deadline
FLIP preserves the presented rectangle and can reverse while expanding
Reduced motion keeps rotation flat and fades without changing app timing
Changing reduced-motion preference cancels flight and settles from current pose
WAAPI tracks contain only transform/opacity and share a clock
A failing WAAPI backend releases effects and uses the actual RAF fallback
Real app: navigate→forming retains the entry; 950ms state and abort still work
Real expand action uses FLIP without replacing the workspace shell
Disposal cancels outstanding work and restores the same DOM nodes
